title: Orzly Hornet AX250-K Light Up Keyboard
descriptionText:
See pics.

Enhance your gaming experience with the Orzly Hornet AX250-K Light Up Keyboard. This keyboard boasts a sleek black design and is perfect for gamers of all levels. The keyboard is wired with a USB connectivity option for easy plug and play use. 

The Orzly Hornet AX250-K Light Up Keyboard features illuminated keys for a stunning visual effect. It is manufactured in China and is available in English keyboard language. This keyboard is perfect for those who are looking for a high-quality gaming keyboard that is both reliable and stylish.
